entities.name: Heteroaryl chloride SNAr
observations: Activated chlorinated diazine/pyrimidine undergoes substitution of C–Cl by cyclohexyl[(cyclopropyl)methyl]amine, forming an exocyclic tertiary amino substituent.
The sulfonamide, benzamide, and heteroaromatic framework are retained; no annulation or ring fusion occurs.

entities.name: Ethanol/diisopropylamine
observations: A directly matching record uses ethanol as solvent and diisopropylamine as base/HCl scavenger for substitution of the activated heteroaryl chloride by the secondary amine.
Heating may be used as needed to reach completion.

entities.name: Cyclohexyl[(cyclopropyl)methyl]amine
observations: This secondary amine is the nucleophile that replaces the heteroaryl chloride.
